cards.text: What is your favorite dumb little thing we do?
What is a tiny habit of mine you noticed before I knew you were paying attention?
What do you tell people about me when I am not there?
What is the first thing you want to do the next time we are in the same room?
What is a song that is ours that I might not know is ours?
What is something you have been saving up to tell me and have not gotten around to?
What is a meal you want to cook for me, and what is the story behind it?
What is the hardest you have laughed on a call with me?
What do you think I am doing when I do not text back for an hour?
What is a picture of me you look at more than you would admit?
What is a stupid argument we have had that you would gladly have again?
What is the best thing I have ever sent you, in the mail or as a message?
What do you miss about the last place we were together that you did not expect to miss?
What is a nickname you call me in your head?
What is something you do before our calls that you have never told me?
What would our perfect lazy Sunday look like, hour by hour?
What is a show or book you have been holding off on so we can do it together?
What is your favorite thing I wear, and should I be worried about why?
When did you last think about me at a weird time, and where were you?
What is a place in your city you want to show me first?
What do my hands look like? Describe them without looking at a photo.
What is something I am good at that I do not give myself credit for?
What is a tiny ritual you want us to start?
What did you think our first conversation was going to lead to?
What is the most you thing you have done this week?
Which of my friends or family do you most want to win over, and why that one?
What is a smell you associate with me?
What do you wish you could hand me through the screen right now?
What is a question you have been nervous to ask me because it felt too soon?
What do you want me to do for you the next time you have had a terrible day?
What is a thing about my voice you only notice on calls?
What small thing would make our next goodbye easier?
When was the last time you felt far from me in a way that had nothing to do with miles?
What do you need from me on the days when the distance feels heaviest?
What is something I do on calls that makes you feel less close, even if I do not mean it?
What do you not tell me because you do not want to make the distance harder?
What part of your life there feels like it is happening without me, and how do you feel about that?
What is a fear about us that you have only said to someone else?
When have you felt like I was not listening, and what did you do with that?
What do you need to hear from me more often?
What is something about the way I handle conflict that you have learned to work around?
Which of my moods is hardest to be on the other end of?
What is a moment I disappointed you that you decided not to bring up?
What have you changed about yourself since we started, and are you okay with it?
What do you worry I will find out about you once we live in the same place?
What do you do with jealousy when it shows up?
What is a small thing I stopped doing that you noticed?
What is something you have forgiven me for that I never knew needed forgiving?
What do you picture when you picture us failing?
What is a way you have tested me without telling me it was a test?
When do you feel most like yourself with me, and when do you feel least?
What do you want to be better at for me that you are embarrassed you are not already?
What is something you have pretended was fine between us?
What do you think I am afraid of about you?
What would you want me to do differently the next time you go quiet?
What did you want to say the last time we said goodbye?
What have you decided about us that you have not told me yet?
What do you resent about the distance that you have been careful not to aim at me?
What do you think we are avoiding talking about?
When was the last time you felt chosen by me? When was the last time you did not?
What part of being alone have you gotten too good at?
What are you afraid will change about us when the distance ends?
What do you do after a bad call with me, before you feel normal again?
What is a compliment from me that you did not believe?
What did you learn about love before me that you are still unlearning?
What is the thing you most need me to never use against you?
What do you want our life to look like in five years, and what part of that are you scared to want?
Where did you learn to be afraid of being left, and how does it show up with me?
What is a wound I have touched without knowing it was there?
What would you need from me to feel safe enough to fall apart?
What do you believe about yourself that makes it hard to believe I love you?
Which moment with me would you relive exactly, and which would you want back to do differently?
What are you scared you will ruin?
What does home mean to you, and am I in it yet?
What do you want me to understand about your family that I cannot see from here?
What is the version of you that only I get, and what does it cost you to show it?
What have you given up for this, and do I know about it?
If we do not make it, what will you be most grateful for?
What do you want me to know about how you were loved as a kid?
What is the hardest thing you have ever had to say to someone you loved, and did you say it?
What is something you need to grieve that you have not let yourself grieve?
What are you most afraid I will see in you up close that the distance has hidden?
What do you want to be true about us that is not true yet?
What do you need me to promise, and what do you need me to stop promising?
When have you felt most loved by me, in a way you could describe to a stranger?
What part of yourself do you keep from me to protect me, and what part do you keep to protect yourself?
What do you think I would be if I had never met you? What would you be?
What is the question about us that you are afraid to know the answer to?
What do you want to be forgiven for that has nothing to do with me?
What did you have to survive to get here, and how much of it do I know?
What is a promise you made yourself about how you would love, and have you kept it with me?
What does it feel like, in your body, when you miss me?
What would you tell me right now if you knew for certain I would never leave?
What do you want the story of us to be when someone asks fifty years from now?
What is the loneliest part of loving someone far away, and have you told me about it?
What do you need me to understand about you that you have given up trying to explain to anyone else?
Write each other the text you would want to receive on your worst day. Send it now. Save it.
Describe the first time you knew you loved the other player, in the present tense, as if it is happening right now.
Both write three things you want from the first week of living in the same place. Reveal and compare.
Count down from three and say your favorite thing about the other person at the same time.
Show each other the last thing you were looking at on your phone before this session. No deleting first.
Tell the other player one thing you need them to do this week. They say yes or they negotiate. Not maybe.
Say the hardest sentence from this session again, slower, looking at the camera.
Each of you writes a one-line toast for a day you are both looking forward to. Read them out loud.
Describe the other player's laugh to a stranger.
Plan the next time you will be together out loud, with a date, even if it is a guess. Put it on a calendar before the next card.
Each of you picks one card from tonight to answer again next week. Star them in the journal.
Both write one sentence that starts with: What I have not said tonight is. Reveal at the same time.
